summary: E2 review iteration 1: full backend + frontend testing of retention/storage/compact, activity-guard (incl. idea-round LLM), move-scanner, plus regression on AITraderSeeding intro/tab. All 18 API tests green; all UI flows verified. No critical issues.

minor.issue: First response is slow (~10s cold, later <1s). Not a bug per se but public gateway edge times out at ~100s for very slow LLM calls.

Can exceed the ingress ~100s cap under LLM latency (returns 502/504 at edge). Locally on :8001 the call completes in ~11s and returns 200 with a full idea payload. Consider adding a shorter LLM timeout with degraded response so the edge never returns 502.

integration_issues.flow: Adaptive tab actions (activity-guard-check-btn, move-scanner-run-btn) and Storage actions (retention-run-btn, compact-run-btn)
integration_issues.issue: Backend calls succeed, but Sonner toast texts were not captured in DOM snapshot after ~4-8s wait; only the retention-days-app_notifications select produced a persistent toast ('Retention app_notifications gespeichert'). Likely just very short toast duration; verified visually via screenshots that panel state updates.

issues: React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' – original select renders EMA-Bezeichnungen inside <option>. Minor, not blocking, but should be cleaned up to remove SSR hydration warning.

action_items: Consider capping LLM wait in /api/ai/activity-guard/idea-round to ~60s and returning status='no_result' on timeout, so the public gateway never returns 502/504.
Clean up hydration warning: no <span> inside <option> in the retention select row (StoragePanel.js).
critical_code_review_comments: Retention policy shape and MIN_DAYS handling work as documented; override roundtrip persists correctly.
Activity-Guard idea-round endpoint correctly requires admin; response payload matches contract (status/rate/target/action/idea).
Move-Scanner status includes all four class_min_move classes; run returns integer count.
Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exclusively (observed via network logs); tokens stored in localStorage under admin_token.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all UI elements render & actions succeed; only toast text capture was flaky)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Public gateway has ~100s read cap; when testing LLM endpoints via public URL always allow local fallback. Use `wait_until='domcontentloaded'` (not networkidle) as many websockets stay open. Backtester is opened via tools-menu-button -> tools-menu-backtester; AI seeding lives inside backtester modal under text tab 'KI Trader · Setups'.
rca of the issue: Not applicable – no functional bugs found. The only observed edge failures were: (a) 502 at public gateway on very slow LLM call – confirmed backend returns 200 within ~11s locally; (b) toast text not captured – timing-related in test scraping, not a product bug.
